instruction: A cinematic video still captures a medium shot of two people dancing in a studio with a soft gradient background. On the left, the man in the black vest (R2) stands in profile facing right, looking toward his partner with a soft smile. On the right, the blonde woman in the black halter dress (R3) faces slightly left, smiling and looking down. She extends her right arm straight out to the left, resting her hand near the man's shoulder. The scene is illuminated by dual-tone studio lighting, featuring a cool cyan glow from the left and a warm pink hue from the right, creating a soft, vibrant atmosphere.
